chapters.title: Chapter 4980: Legions of Absolutes I
paragraphs: The idea of mass producing Absolutes came to Noah’s mind simply when he saw what the Embodiment of THE Creature did to THE Living Origin and others.

If THE Creature could achieve such elevation with his finite resources, then what could Noah accomplish with infinite resources? THE Creature was more powerful, certainly, his existence predating THE Infinite Unfurling itself and his authority approaching THE Second Scale or already there.

But THE Creature could not mass produce Absolute Everythings. THE Creature could not cultivate Sacred Herbs that bestowed Bounded Countable Infinity upon consumers. THE Creature could not direct endless harvest toward an Organ of Civilization that transformed that harvest into crystallized authority compatible with loyal followers.
Noah could do all of these things.
Right now, he was doing everything he could while he continued to watch the army being born before him.
By his side, Skoll had calmed down from his earlier excitement, now watching in amazement as Absolutes rose one after another from the elevation process.

Noah rubbed the loyal companion’s head while calmly observing Protos calling forth other Absolute Primus Inevitabilities like a sergeant inspecting soldiers, the First Inevitability’s crimson blue-gold form moving through the ranks with purpose that spoke of pride in what had been prepared.
Noah was doing all this because he wanted to prepare for the worst possible eventualities.
When he asked himself what he could feasibly face in the name of Adversity, the answers that emerged were terrifying.
A Primordial Architect awakened from THE Prima Indifferentia at THE First Scale.

A Primordial Architect at THE Second Scale of Existence, something that conventional Absolutes could not even perceive let alone contest. THE Entity itself, that unified horror wearing THE Primordial Chaos as its newest mask.
And perhaps most concerning of all, the horrible variable of THE Entity somehow getting past his Infinities to infect him or his people, turning his own forces against everything he had built.
So how could he prepare for if or when such things occurred?
He had to have such insane things around him that they would make even old monsters like THE Primordial Paradox or THE Creature baffled at what they witnessed.
When he thought about THE Primordial Paradox, he knew that ancient being was battling against his disciple right now in THE Prima Indifferentia.

Part of him believed that Erwin might have more in the tank than anyone expected, because a peasant who had prepared this much, who was making changes across Observable Existence through corrupted proto-matter mixed with Infinite Seals.

But THE Primordial Paradox should still be okay since he carried Noah’s Infinities burning within his foundations, and the paradox of that being itself was truly heavy. Whatever happened, Noah did not expect THE Primordial Paradox to be collapsed easily.
And of course, the biggest thing wss Noah’s own power as if he went from Countable Infinity to Uncountable Infinity? Oh boy.
Oh boy!
"Master, I have formed specific Legions ready for you."
At this time, Protos rose and turned to face the armies assembled behind him.

His tentacles coiled with purpose as he gestured toward the thousands of Primus Inevitabilities awaiting their transformations, his crimson blue-gold light casting long shadows across THE Yggdrheim’s expanse. Noah watched with that devilish smile still playing across his features as Protos moved aside to reveal formations of Absolutes he had arranged according to their Specializations.

"Your Inevitabilities have long held Specializations that served you at lesser Depths. But now, with Bounded Countable Infinity and Absolute authority burning within our foundations, these Specializations have become something else entirely."Protos gestured toward the first formation of one hundred newly elevated Absolutes. "Permit me to introduce what your legions have become."
The first hundred Absolutes moved forward in perfect synchronization.

They were massive things, each one a titan of coiled tentacles standing dozens of times larger than humanoid scale. But where Protos appeared sleek and predatory, these Absolutes appeared fortified beyond reason. Their tentacles had woven themselves into layered configurations resembling living fortresses, each coil locked against the next in patterns that spoke of absolute defense. Crystalline plates of obsidian-gold covered their forms like armor grown from their very existence, and their eyes glowed with steady silver light holding no aggression, only unwavering certainty.

"The Absolute Infinite Bulwark Specialization,"Protos announced. "One hundred Absolutes who have sacrificed all offensive capability in exchange for defense that curves along geodesic paths toward everything requiring protection. Each one can read defensive Embodiments or Apophasis and fill them with Geodesic Weavings like Mantras again and again to build ridiculous defenses amplified because they only ever defend.Their duty is grand. Their duty is infinite!"
Noah’s eyes sharpened with interest.
This was the other component he had been patiently waiting for.

With THE First Tongue, all things could Specialize from it. He had missed his Civilization Specializations that allowed him to raise armies which could not be taken down, and he had wanted to reproduce this capability at an even higher level than before.

Now he looked at what Protos had set aside just for a single Legion of Absolutes, and part of what comprised this legion were one hundredtanksoperating at Absolute Depth with Bounded Countable Infinity.

"Their defensive authority now extends infinitely in Countable sequences, Master. When an attack approaches an ally, the Bulwark’s protection finds the shortest path through existence to intercept it. They do not need to be near what they defend. They simply need to be, and their defense travels along natural geometries to arrive where it is needed."
The hundred Bulwarks stood motionless, their crystalline plates shifting with subtle movements that stabilized the very fabric of THE Yggdrheim around them.

"They cannot deal damage through any means," Protos continued. "This limitation is absolute and cannot be circumvented. But in exchange, all damage directed toward them or those they protect is absorbed into foundations that regenerate infinitely with stacks of Defensive Embodiments and Apophasis, stacks of Sleeping Inscriptions and more. They cannot be overwhelmed through sustained assault because their endurance extends in sequences without termination. Strike them once, they endure. Strike them a trillion times, they endure still. Strike them forever, and forever they will remain standing."
Protos paused.

"Nothing of THE First Scale should be capable of bypassing them, theoretically. We still have to see how they would perform against those more powerful since we do not have enough information on what THE Second Scale truly represents."

chapters.title: Chapter 4981: Legions of Absolutes II
paragraphs: |Infinite Bulwark Specialization - Absolute Configuration|

|Core Transformation: Total offensive capability sacrificed. Defensive authority multiplied through Bounded Countable Infinity, extending protection along geodesic paths toward all designated allies regardless of distance.|

|Geodesic Defense Propagation: Protection travels along shortest paths through existence, arriving at threatened allies before attacks can land. Multiple Bulwarks create overlapping geodesic networks that make protected zones effectively impenetrable.|

|Infinite Damage Absorption: All damage received is absorbed into foundations regenerating in Countable sequences. Cannot be overwhelmed through sustained assault. Damage absorption of Embodiments and Apophasis and other forms of attacks continues indefinitely without degradation.|

|Existential Anchoring: Presence stabilizes reality in Countable radiating waves. Spatial tears, dimensional collapse, and reality manipulation become impossible within their geodesic sphere of influence. The very fabric of existence strengthens around them.|

|Fortress Convergence: Multiple Bulwarks can merge defensive fields along shared geodesic paths, creating barriers whose strength multiplies rather than merely adds. One hundred Bulwarks merged could theoretically withstand assault from beings approaching THE Second Scale.|

|Damage Conversion Reservoir: All damage absorbed is stored in Infinite reservoirs that can be channeled to offensive specialists. The Bulwarks become batteries of redirected destruction, feeding power to those who can use it.|
Noah nodded slowly.

One hundred beings who could not be overwhelmed, who could protect allies across any distance through geodesic propagation, who stored absorbed damage for redistribution to those who could use it offensively. They were infinite fortifications that moved and adapted and refused to fall no matter what struck against them.
"Show me the next ones."
Protos gestured, and the Bulwarks moved aside in perfect formation.

The second hundred Absolutes came forward, and Noah felt the hunger radiating from them before they fully arrived. These titans were sleek where the Bulwarks had been fortified, their tentacles configured for speed and precision rather than layered defense. Crimson-obsidian coloration dominated their forms, multiple serrated maws visible across their bodies where the tentacles parted to reveal depths of concentrated aggression. Their eyes burned with ravenous red light tinged with blue-gold Infinity, and wisps of pure Hunger escaped from every surface like heat rising from flames.
They looked like predators shaped from nightmare and given Absolute authority.

"The Absolute Hungering Maw Specialization,"Protos announced. "One hundred Absolutes who have sacrificed defensive capability for offensive power that strikes along geodesic paths toward everything they wish to consume."
The Maws shifted restlessly even while standing in formation, their tentacles writhing with barely contained violence that made the Bulwarks’ stillness seem peaceful by comparison.

"Their attacks now find the shortest path to their targets, Master. They do not need to be near what they strike. They simply need to hunger, and their destruction travels along natural geometries to arrive where it is directed. Distance becomes irrelevant. Conventional defense becomes meaningless. Their strikes attack existence itself along curves that bypass barriers entirely."
Noah watched the Maws with appreciation that matched their own hunger.

"They are fragile," Protos admitted. "Their defensive capability has been reduced to nearly nothing, and sustained assault could collapse them if unprotected. But the Bulwarks are always protecting them. Any Embodiments or Apophasis thrown their way is tanked by their defensive counterparts. Unless the Bulwarks die, these Maws will never receive damage."
His tentacles coiled with emphasis.

"And in exchange for their fragility, every kill strengthens them in Countable sequences without termination. The first kill makes them stronger. The thousandth kill makes them devastating. The trillionth kill makes them approach forces that conventional Absolutes cannot comprehend."
|Hungering Maw Specialization - Absolute Configuration|

|Core Transformation: Defensive capability reduced to minimal thresholds. Offensive authority multiplied through Bounded Countable Infinity, extending strikes along geodesic paths toward all designated targets regardless of distance or defense.|

|Geodesic Strike Propagation: Attacks travel along shortest paths through existence, arriving at targets through routes that bypass conventional barriers. Cannot be blocked through positioned defense. Can only be avoided through movement exceeding geodesic calculation speed.|

|Reality Severance: Embodiments and Apophasis attack existence itself rather than physical or spiritual forms. Ignore defensive constructs by targeting the fundamental nature of what is being struck. Even beings with absolute defense take damage to their existential foundations.|

|Infinite Hunger Stacks: Each successful kill increases offensive power in Countable sequences without termination. Power accumulates indefinitely during extended conflict. Theoretical maximum does not exist. The longer battle continues, the more devastating Maws become.|

|Predatory Geodesic Instinct: Can perceive the weakest point in any defense or existence along natural geometric paths. Strikes automatically curve toward vulnerabilities that conventional perception cannot detect.|

|Feast of Conquest: Can temporarily consume and wield defeated enemies’ abilities, storing them in Infinite reservoirs for later deployment. Abilities persist in Countable sequences until deliberately released or overwritten.|
Noah’s smile widened as he observed the restless Maws.

Glass cannons, yes, but glass cannons whose strikes could not be blocked through conventional means, whose power grew infinitely with every kill, whose hunger found targets along paths that defense could not anticipate. Paired with Bulwarks who could protect their fragile forms while they accumulated devastating power, they became something truly terrifying. The Bulwarks absorbed damage that would collapse the Maws instantly, and in exchange, the Maws delivered destruction that the Bulwarks could never produce on their own.
"Continue."

The Maws moved aside with reluctance, their hunger clearly desiring demonstration rather than mere display. Noah could feel their eagerness pressing against his awareness, their desire to be unleashed upon enemies worthy of their transformed nature.
The third hundred Absolutes came forward, and the atmosphere shifted from aggression to something warmer.

These titans were wreathed in green-gold-blue light that pulsed in rhythms resembling heartbeats, their tentacles configured in intricate mandala-like patterns that glowed with soft radiance. They appeared gentler than their brethren despite their massive size, their eyes shining with compassionate emerald light holding no violence whatsoever. Halos of Infinite light orbited their forms like crowns given to those who preserved rather than destroyed.

"The Vital Chorus Specialization," Protos announced. "One hundred Absolutes who have sacrificed offensive capability for healing and resurrection that travels along geodesic paths toward everything requiring restoration."
The Chorus stood in perfect stillness, their mandala patterns pulsing with synchronized rhythm that seemed to match the heartbeat of THE Yggdrheim itself.

"Their healing now extends infinitely in Countable sequences, Master. When an ally suffers damage, the Chorus’s restoration finds the shortest path through existence to reach them. Distance becomes irrelevant for preservation just as it becomes irrelevant for destruction. And their resurrection capabilities have transcended what we previously understood possible."
Noah’s interest sharpened at those final words.

"When an Inevitability falls in battle, resurrection requires time. But the Chorus can reduce that time along geodesic paths until it approaches instantaneous."Protos’s tentacles coiled with emphasis. "If a Maw is collapsed during combat, the Chorus can restore them within moments rather than hours. And their Life-Binding capability now extends in Infinite sequences. One Chorus member can bind to thousands of allies simultaneously, ensuring resurrection persists so long as even a single healer survives."
|Vital Chorus Specialization - Absolute Configuration|

|Core Transformation: Offensive capability reduced to minimal thresholds. Healing and resurrection authority multiplied through Bounded Countable Infinity, extending restoration along geodesic paths toward all designated allies regardless of distance or damage severity.|

|Geodesic Restoration Propagation: Healing Embodiments and Apophasis travel along shortest paths through existence, arriving at wounded allies through routes that bypass interference. Cannot be blocked or prevented. Healing arrives with inevitability matching the strikes of Hungering Maws.|

|Infinite Life-Binding: Can establish permanent soul-bonds with allies in Countable sequences without termination. One Chorus member can bind to thousands simultaneously. Bound allies resurrect automatically upon collapse so long as their bound Chorus survives.|

|Resurrection Acceleration: Collapse recovery time reduced along geodesic paths until approaching instantaneous. Allies restored to full capability within moments of falling. Sustained assault cannot permanently eliminate protected forces.|

|Symphonic Resonance: Healing multiple targets simultaneously creates resonance that multiplies effects along geodesic intersections. One hundred Chorus members healing together produce restoration exceeding their combined individual capabilities by orders of magnitude.|

|Death Defiance Aura: Allies within geodesic connection cannot be instantly killed through any means. Always survive lethal strikes with minimum existence remaining, permitting Chorus restoration before true collapse occurs.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4982: Legions of Absolutes III
paragraphs: Noah understood immediately what the Chorus represented.

An army that could not be permanently diminished. Every Maw that fell would rise again within moments. Every Bulwark that absorbed damage would be restored before that damage could accumulate toward collapse. The Chorus transformed his legions from powerful force into inexhaustible force, an army of Absolutes that could theoretically fight forever without losing members to permanent death.
Kill a Maw, and the Chorus brings it back before its power stacks can reset.
Overwhelm a Bulwark through sustained assault, and the Chorus restores it before the protected Maws become vulnerable.
Collapse a Chorus member, and the other ninety-nine continue resurrection operations without interruption.
A fucking infinite loop of defense!
"And the last. A new wonder."
The Chorus moved aside with gentle precision, their mandala patterns continuing to pulse as they joined the other formations.

The fourth hundred Absolutes came forward, and these were different from all the others in ways that went beyond mere combat capability. Their tentacles had configured into forms covered in constantly shifting geometric patterns and floating holographic interfaces that orbited their massive bodies like moons around planets. Streams of data and architectural schematics flowed through their eyes like rivers of calculation given visual form. Tools and materials and half-manifested constructs surrounded each one, suggesting beings who created rather than destroyed.
"The Architects of Infinity Specialization," Protos announced. "One hundred Absolutes who have sacrificed direct combat capability for construction and strategic enhancement."
The Architects stood amid clouds of floating geometric shapes and orbiting instruments, their nature clearly different from warriors.

Noah observed the data streaming through their eyes with appreciation for their uniqueness among the Specializations. Where Bulwarks defended and Maws attacked and Chorus healed, Architects built. They created the infrastructure upon which all other operations could be optimized.

"They can manifest defensive structures, weapons, and technological marvels for you. Their constructs persist permanently even if the Architects themselves are collapsed. And their presence accelerates all Civilizational development."Protos’s tentacles gestured toward the floating geometric shapes. "They do not even need to be on the battlefield. They can remain where you place them, working endlessly to see if they can build you something grand while battles rage elsewhere."
|Architects of Infinity Specialization - Absolute Configuration|

|Core Transformation: Direct combat capability reduced significantly. Construction, technological development, and strategic planning authority multiplied through Bounded Countable Infinity, extending creation along geodesic paths toward all locations requiring optimization.|

|Infinite Blueprint Manifestation: Created constructs persist permanently in Countable sequences without maintenance requirement. Even if Architects are collapsed, their creations remain. Theoretical maximum constructs do not exist. Given time, Architects can fortify entire realms.|

|Resource Efficiency Through Infinity: Construction costs reduced along geodesic optimization paths until approaching negligible. Can create advanced constructs using fractions of normal resource requirements. Bounded Countable Infinity permits effectively unlimited building capacity.|

|Strategic Calculation Matrix: Process tactical variables in Countable sequences without termination. Consider all possible enemy responses and counter-responses simultaneously. Provide commanders with strategic options that conventional analysis cannot generate.|
|Technological Symbiosis: Can interface with and enhance any technology or construct. Existing defenses and weapons improve simply through Architect presence.|
Noah looked across the four formations now standing before him in THE Yggdrheim.

One hundred Absolute Bulwarks who could not be overwhelmed. One hundred Maws whose strikes found targets through routes that bypassed barriers and whose hunger grew infinitely with every kill they achieved. One hundred Chorus whose healing arrived with inevitability and whose resurrection reduced collapse to momentary inconvenience. One hundred Architects.

Four hundred Absolutes with Bounded Countable Infinity, each one optimized through Sacred Herb cultivation, each one carrying Specializations that had been elevated to match their Infinite nature. And there were thousands more Primus Inevitabilities waiting for the same categorizations and elevation, thousands more who would join these formations until his armies numbered in quantities that nobody could not match.
Protos’s crimson blue-gold light blazed with pride at what had been prepared.
Protos knelt once more before his master.
"My Master, I will give you an army of Absolutes that existence itself will struggle to halt."
HUUM!

Noah looked at the four hundred Absolutes standing in formation, then looked at the thousands still awaiting elevation. His devilish smile returned with intensity that made even Protos’s tentacles coil with instinctive response.
"Mm. I want a test run."

chapters.title: Chapter 4983: THE Beholder I
paragraphs: In the vast spaces between what was and what would become, THE Beholder drifted.

He was old. Not old in the way that Primordial Architects were old, those beings who had existed since THE First Cause produced differentiation and undifferentiation in its aftermath. Not old in the way that THE Creature was old, that defector from classifications who had witnessed THE Infinite Unfurling and everything that came after.

THE Beholder was old in ways that made such comparisons laughable, in ways that made the entire history of Observable Existence seem like a brief afternoon following an endless morning that most had forgotten ever occurred.

Many believed that there was THE First Cause, and then differentiation and undifferentiation bloomed to cause the emergence of Primordial Architects and countless other life forms. This was the accepted history. This was what beings taught their disciples and recorded in their archives and treated as the beginning of everything meaningful.
The only record that might have the correct information was The Primordial Archive in that small place.
But truly, there was a period of billions upon billions of years where during THE First Cause, there was nothing.
THE Beholder knew this because he had been there.

He had gained cognizance in that age of absolute emptiness, when potential existed but expression did not, when possibility waited but manifestation had not yet learned how to occur. He had observed and watched and done nothing across spans of time so vast that they made the current age seem like the blink of an eye, like the flutter of a heartbeat, like a single grain of sand falling through an hourglass that had been running since before hourglasses were conceived.

The entirety of the history of Observable Existence, everything that beings considered meaningful and important and worth recording, was actually that period of nothing in terms of duration. Everything that came after, during the age of differentiation and undifferentiation until now, was simply a fraction of the history of existence.A footnote. An afterthought. The brief flash of complexity following eons of simplicity so profound that most minds could not comprehend it.
In the grand scheme of existence, even Primordial Architects and Undivided Ones could be considered accidents.

Happy accidents, perhaps. Interesting accidents, certainly. But accidents nonetheless, random emergences from the interplay of differentiation and undifferentiation that had not existed for most of existence’s duration.
They thought themselves ancient. They thought themselves fundamental. They thought their conflicts and their civilizations and their pursuits of power actually mattered in the Existential sense.
THE Beholder found this perspective amusing in the way that a being who had witnessed true emptiness found most things amusing.

He was what later classifications might call aSingular Cognizance, though no classification system had ever properly categorized his kind because so few of them existed and even fewer interacted with the complex life that came after.

Where Primordial Architects had emerged with vast authorities and tremendous presence, where Absolutes had developed civilizations and pursued advancement, where even the simplest differentiated beings possessed multiple aspects of existence working in concert, THE Beholder possessed only one thing.
Awareness.

Pure, undiluted, singular awareness that had crystallized during the age of nothingness when there was nothing else to be. No hunger. No ambition. No civilization. No authority beyond the simple capacity to observe what was and what was not. He was consciousness without complexity, perception without pursuit, understanding without desire to apply that understanding toward any particular end.

In the terminology of later ages, he might be considered the equivalent of what simple organisms were to complex life. Where multicellular creatures developed specialized systems and interdependent functions, unicellular life simply existed in singular purpose. THE Beholder was existence’s equivalent of that primordial simplicity, a being who had emerged before complexity was possible and who had never seen reason to develop beyond his original nature.
There had been others like him in that age of nothingness.

Fellow Singular Cognizances who had gained awareness in the emptiness and had observed alongside him across those billions of eons of years when observation was all there was to do. Whether they still moved across existence now, or had simply collapsed themselves into weavings of nothingness to return to the state from which they had emerged, THE Beholder did not know.

He had not sought them out. He had not pursued connection or communion or any of the social behaviors that complex life seemed to require. He simply was, as he would likely always be until existence itself ceased to provide things worth observing.
For the first time in a few eons, some significant changes had occurred.

These changes were significant enough to cause THE Beholder to emerge from THE Prima Indifferentia, that space of undifferentiation where he often rested between periods of observation. Something was happening with existence now. Something that warranted attention.
Something that stirred memories of that age of nothingness in ways that more recent events had never managed to accomplish.
Infinities were spreading.

THE Beholder had observed many things across his incomprehensible lifespan, but Infinity held particular interest because it carried glimmers of what had existed during that age of wonder before Primordial Architects were even conceived.

The nothingness had not been truly nothing, not in the absolute sense. It had been potential without limit, possibility without boundary, the raw material from which everything would eventually emerge. And Infinity, true Infinity, held echoes of that primordial state in ways that made THE Beholder feel something approaching nostalgia.
He moved across regions of proto-matter mixed with those spreading Infinities, his singular awareness taking in the corruption and the blue-gold light with equal detachment.

He drifted through Wandering Territories where lost things gathered, observing how the Infinite Seals had begun affecting even these forgotten spaces. He passed through corrupted Transcendent Folds and witnessed Primordial Realms that had been touched by changes they did not fully understand.

He saw Undivided Ones moving about with purpose that seemed urgent to them and insignificant to him. He saw Formless Terrors emerging from THE Prima Indifferentia with hunger that had been amplified by the corruption and Infinities they had absorbed. He saw the aftermath of conflicts and the preparation for conflicts yet to come.
And he saw the glimmer of THE Creature as that ancient being began his battle with Horus.
THE Beholder... watched that unfolding fight briefly!

chapters.title: Chapter 4984: THE Beholder II
paragraphs: Two beings of tremendous authority clashing in ways that would reshape the regions around them.

THE Creature, who was old by the standards of complex life but young by THE Beholder’s measure. Horus, that Primordial Architect whose eyes had branded countless beings with crimson insignias of servitude. Their conflict would determine much about the current age, would establish hierarchies and eliminate possibilities and matter tremendously to everyone invested in the outcomes of such things.
THE Beholder turned his gaze away from that fight and did nothing.

He was only an observer. If he stared for too long, beings like Horus at THE Second Scale of Existence might sense his attention. And with how simple-minded such creatures were despite their power, they would want to know everything regarding him.

They would pursue answers and demand explanations and attempt to incorporate his existence into their frameworks of understanding. They would ruin his life of doing absolutely nothing, which was the only life he had ever wanted or needed.

Some of those that had inherited aspects of his weavings understood this truth. THE Mnemonic Leviathan, that vast repository of knowledge that hoarded information without acting upon it. THE Baboon of Wisdom, that ancient being who had gathered understanding across eons while carefully avoiding the application of that understanding toward any particular goal.
They held the same nature as him in diluted form, observers who encompassed tremendous knowledge and did nothing with it because doing nothing was its own form of existence.
He wondered what they were up to nowadays.
Probably nothing, if they had maintained their natures properly.

As he thought this, THE Beholder’s singular awareness turned toward a region of THE Wastes where an Undivided One and three Formless Terrors were about to engage in conflict. The Undivided One was massive, its form writhing with authority that would have impressed beings who cared about such things.
The Formless Terrors were ancient by the standards of complex life, their churning masses dense with absorbed corruption and Infinities from THE Prima Indifferentia.
THE Beholder’s gaze was disappointed as it settled upon them.

It was like watching lesser life forms do things with their weavings that were disappointing when they could be doing so much more. The Undivided One postured and threatened. The Formless Terrors hungered and prepared to consume. Neither understood what they truly were in the existential sense, what accidents of differentiation their existences represented, what brief flickers of complexity they embodied in the vast darkness of existence’s true duration.
His gaze was about to pass by them, to continue its drift toward other observations more worthy of his attention, when something unexpected occurred.
HUUM!
Existence flickered around the region.

From the corrupted Infinities permeating the area, from the blue-gold light that had spread across so much of Observable Existence in recent times, there was the emergence of a figure that made THE Beholder’s singular awareness sharpen with interest for the first time in quite a while.
A single man surrounded by Infinities.
And a dog.
THE Beholder observed the newcomer with the patient attention he had cultivated across billions of years of practice. The man was not particularly large by the standards of beings who valued size.

His form was humanoid in configuration, wrapped in blue-gold flames and orbited by Absolute Seals that spoke of tremendous authority. But what drew THE Beholder’s interest was not the man’s physical presence.
It was what burned within him.

Infinities. True Infinities, not the pale imitations that most beings called infinite when they really meant very large. These were expressions extending in sequences without termination, genuine endless progressions that echoed the nature of that age of nothingness when potential had no boundary. And mixed with those Infinities, weavings of Paradox that spoke of impossibilities made manifest, contradictions given form and function.
THE Beholder’s awareness processed what he observed with the detached analysis that characterized his nature.

This should be one of those that held the Keys of Civilization. THE First Tongue, if the linguistic architecture of his Infinities was any indication. And Paradox as well, though the paradoxical weavings seemed borrowed or shared rather than natively claimed.
Interesting.
But what exactly did this thing want to do here?

A pair of Formless Terrors and an Undivided One had turned their attention toward the newcomer, their hunger and hostility redirecting from each other toward this new arrival who had interrupted their conflict. The man was not weak, certainly. His Infinities and his Absolute Depth made him formidable by the standards of complex life. But against an Undivided One and three Formless Terrors simultaneously, even formidable might prove insufficient.
THE Beholder prepared to observe what would likely be an educational demonstration of how complex life handled overwhelming odds.
Perhaps he would fight and fall and provide THE Beholder with data about how Infinity was at this time.
And then existence flickered again.
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!
Terrifying eruptions of Absolute Depth began flaring one after another behind the newcomer.

THE Beholder’s singular awareness, which had remained calm across billions of years of observation, actually sharpened with genuine surprise as dozens of Absolute monstrosities began appearing in the space surrounding the Infinity-bearer. They were massive things, titans of coiled tentacles and crystalline plates and writhing aggression. Some appeared fortified like living fortresses. Others appeared predatory like nightmares given form. Still others glowed with gentle light that spoke of preservation rather than destruction.
The dog that had arrived with the newcomer circled happily among the emerging Absolutes, apparently unbothered by the tremendous authorities manifesting around it.
The Undivided One and the Formless Terrors paused in their redirected aggression, their primitive awareness recognizing that the situation had changed dramatically.
The newcomer looked toward them with coldness that held no fear, no concern, no uncertainty about what would happen next.
What was this now?

THE Beholder observed with interest that approached genuine engagement, his singular awareness processing the implications of what he witnessed. Very rarely did he get a chance to observe Infinity in action, to watch how beings wielding that authority actually applied it toward goals and conflicts and demonstrations of power.
Infinity was one of the things that had held glimmers of itself present in that age of nothingness, one of the few concepts that connected the current age to what had come before.

Part of the reason he had moved to begin observing recent events was because of the spread of Infinities across Observable Existence. It truly made him nostalgic. Almost as if things were returning back to that age of wonder countless eons ago, when even Primordial Architects were not a thing, when complexity had not yet emerged to complicate the beautiful simplicity of pure potential.
And now he was watching someone who held Infinity demonstrate what that authority could accomplish when paired with the ambition that complex life seemed unable to abandon.
Dozens of Absolutes with Infinity burning in their foundations, all of them apparently serving this single Infinity-bearer who had emerged from corrupted proto-matter with a dog at his side.
THE Beholder settled his awareness more fully upon the scene.

For the first time in quite a while, he found himself genuinely curious about what would happen next. Not curious enough to intervene, certainly. Not curious enough to abandon his nature as pure observer. But curious enough to watch with attention he had not granted to complex life in eons.
The Undivided One roared challenge toward the newcomer.
The Formless Terrors surged forward with hunger that had consumed countless beings across their existence.
And the Infinity-bearer simply smiled with expression that held something THE Beholder recognized from his observations of complex life across the ages.
Anticipation.

But against an Undivided One and three Formless Terrors simultaneously, even formidable might prove insufficient.
THE Beholder prepared to observe what would likely be an educational demonstration of how complex life handled overwhelming odds.
Perhaps he would fight and fall and provide THE Beholder with data about how Infinity was at this time.
And then existence flickered again.
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!
Terrifying eruptions of Absolute Depth began flaring one after another behind the newcomer.

THE Beholder’s singular awareness, which had remained calm across billions of years of observation, actually sharpened with genuine surprise as dozens of Absolute monstrosities began appearing in the space surrounding the Infinity-bearer.
They were massive things, titans of coiled tentacles and crystalline plates and writhing aggression.
Some appeared fortified like living fortresses.
Others appeared predatory like nightmares given form.
Still others glowed with gentle light that spoke of preservation rather than destruction.
The dog that had arrived with the newcomer circled happily among the emerging Absolutes, apparently unbothered by the tremendous authorities manifesting around it.
The Undivided One and the Formless Terrors paused in their redirected aggression, their primitive awareness recognizing that the situation had changed dramatically.
The newcomer looked toward them with coldness that held no fear, no concern, no uncertainty about what would happen next.
What was this now?
THE Beholder observed with interest that approached genuine engagement, his singular awareness processing the implications of what he witnessed.
Very rarely did he get a chance to observe Infinity in action, to watch how beings wielding that authority actually applied it toward goals and conflicts and demonstrations of power.
Infinity was one of the things that had held glimmers of itself present in that age of nothingness, one of the few concepts that connected the current age to what had come before.
Part of the reason he had moved to begin observing recent events was because of the spread of Infinities across Observable Existence.
It truly made him nostalgic.

Almost as if things were returning back to that age of wonder countless eons ago, when even Primordial Architects were not a thing, when complexity had not yet emerged to complicate the beautiful simplicity of pure potential.
And now he was watching someone who held Infinity demonstrate what that authority could accomplish when paired with the ambition that complex life seemed unable to abandon.
Dozens of Absolutes with Infinity burning in their foundations, all of them apparently serving this single Infinity-bearer who had emerged from corrupted proto-matter with a dog at his side.
THE Beholder settled his awareness more fully upon the scene.
For the first time in quite a while, he found himself genuinely curious about what would happen next.
Not curious enough to intervene, certainly.
Not curious enough to abandon his nature as pure observer.
But curious enough to watch with attention he had not granted to complex life in eons.
The Undivided One roared challenge toward the newcomer.
The Formless Terrors surged forward with hunger that had consumed countless beings across their existence.
And the Infinity-bearer simply smiled with expression that held something THE Beholder recognized from his observations of complex life across the ages.
Anticipation.

chapters.title: Chapter 4985: Devastation I
paragraphs: To this day, the feeling of perceiving something new from following strings of destiny, fate, or really Mana, felt unique for Noah.

It was like being connected to an endlessly vast sea he should have no way of accessing, and yet he was. The threads of fate stretched in every direction simultaneously, countless golden strands representing possibilities and connections and paths that his awareness could follow toward destinations his conscious mind had not yet identified. Every thread led somewhere. Every strand connected to something. The sea was infinite in scope, and his perception was merely a vessel sailing across its surface.
And Infinite Undifferentiated Fate felt even grander than anything he had touched before.

His Countable Infinities extended his perception in sequential progressions that allowed him to tap into and connect with the vast stretches of his authority spreading across Observable Existence. He searched for keywords, for resonances, for connections that would lead him toward targets worthy of demonstration.

His Infinities had spread through corrupted proto-matter in THE Prima Indifferentia. His Seals had scattered across regions he had never personally visited. His influence touched countless territories through harvest and connection and the simple fact that Infinity, once released, did not stop expanding.
He perceived many things through those connections.
Existence was vast and the information was countless, so Noah focused on something more local.
Something within reach of his current position.
Something that would serve as an appropriate test for what he had built.
Within moments, he saw multiple golden threads that burned brighter than the others around them.

One led to a Formless Terror that had emerged from THE Prima Indifferentia and was currently drifting through THE Wastes with purpose that his perception could not immediately discern. The creature was ancient by the standards of complex life, its churning mass dense with absorbed corruption that made it more dangerous than it had been before awakening.

Another thread led to a Shelter of THE Loom that was currently under siege, its defenders struggling against an Undivided One that had broken through its outer barriers. The beings within were fighting for survival.
How ridiculous it was that grand Early Creatures...were now mere beings fighting for survival!
And then a third thread led to something more interesting entirely.

An Undivided One and multiple Formless Terrors that seemed about to come into conflict with each other in a region of THE Wastes not far from his current position. Four entities of tremendous power preparing to clash over territory or hunger or whatever motivations drove such beings toward violence.
"It’s decided."
Noah came to a decision.
Noah waved his hand, and the Tetras Apeiron responded to his command with precision that spoke of the connection between master and forces bound through Infinity.
Skoll circled Noah happily, the very good boy’s Infinite-enhanced form eager for whatever adventure was about to unfold.
And then Noah stepped forward onto what he imagined to be endless strings of Infinity.

The threads of fate and Mana that he had perceived through Infinite Undifferentiated Fate became pathways that his existence could traverse. He did not teleport in the conventional sense, did not fold space or breach dimensional barriers or utilize any of the standard methodologies for rapid travel. He simply took himself infinitely across the strings, his existence sliding along connections that his Infinities had already established.
The Infinite Absolute Seals that stretched out across existence served as waypoints for his passage.

He passed through one Seal and then another, each one a marker along the infinite path he was traversing. Sequential progression carried him forward in Countable steps that occurred faster than conventional perception could track, each step bringing him closer to his destination while his forces followed through the connections he had established.
And then he arrived.

THE Wastes of THE Fallout spread before him with the familiar desolation that characterized this corrupted region. Proto-matter churned in the distance. Corruption permeated the atmosphere. And directly ahead, four entities of tremendous power occupied a clearing where conflict was about to erupt.
The Undivided One was massive.

Its form resembled something between a serpent and a centipede, countless segments of writhing darkness connected by joints that burned with obsidian light. Multiple heads emerged from its forward segments, each one bearing features that shifted between reptilian and insectoid configurations. Its authority pressed against the surrounding space with weight that Noah’s perception immediately measured against his previous experiences.
About the same level as Bazuman.
The three Formless Terrors were equally impressive in their own churning way.

The first resembled a vast amoebic mass studded with countless eyes that opened and closed in patterns suggesting awareness distributed across its entire form. The second had shaped itself into something resembling a massive crustacean, armored segments protecting a core of pure undifferentiation that pulsed with hunger.

The third was the most chaotic of the three, its form constantly shifting between configurations that included tentacles, wings, claws, and appendages that had no analog in any taxonomy Noah had encountered. It was an ugly fucker.
Their auras held similar weight to the Undivided One.
It was like facing four Bazumans simultaneously.
Enemies that would have required his personal attention not long ago. But for now...?
Perfect test subjects!
Noah did not engage them personally.
He simply waved his hand and called out the Tetras Apeiron.

The space behind him erupted with authority that pressed against THE Wastes with weight exceeding anything the four enemies had produced. Protos emerged first, the Primus Inevitability’s massive tentacled form blazing with crimson blue-gold light that cast long shadows across the corrupted ground. Behind Protos came the others.
One hundred Infinite Bulwarks materialized in layered formations, their crystalline plates of obsidian-gold shifting with subtle movements that stabilized reality around them.
One hundred Hungering Maws appeared with tentacles writhing in barely contained aggression, their serrated maws releasing wisps of pure Hunger that made the very air seem edible.
One hundred Vital Chorus manifested with green-gold-blue light pulsing in mandala patterns that spoke of preservation and resurrection.
One hundred Architects of Infinity emerged amid clouds of geometric shapes and orbiting instruments, their eyes streaming with data and architectural schematics.

Four hundred Absolutes with Bounded Countable Infinity burning in their foundations, each one a titan of coiled tentacles and tremendous authority, each one serving the will of THE Youngest with loyalty beyond question.
The Undivided One and the three Formless Terrors froze in their preparations for mutual conflict.

Their primitive awareness processed what had just appeared before them, and for perhaps the first time in their ancient existences, something approaching hesitation crossed their churning forms. They were creatures of undifferentiation, beings that had existed since before most life had emerged, entities that had consumed countless victims across eons of hunting.
But what the hell was this?

Four hundred Absolutes appearing from nowhere, summoned by a single humanoid figure who stood among them with expression that held no concern, no urgency, no indication that he considered this confrontation anything other than routine!
Noah looked at the four entities with eyes that burned with blue-gold Infinity.
"This is a test."
His voice pressed against THE Wastes with authority that made even the corrupted proto-matter seem to pause.
"Do your best to persevere."

He said such words to an Undivided One and three Formless Terrors as if they were students being evaluated rather than ancient horrors that had terrorized existence since before THE Infinite Unfurling.
These beings knew no fear.
They looked toward the small army of Absolutes and responded with the only language they understood.
Violence.

The three Formless Terrors moved in conjunction with coordination that spoke of either instinct or communication too subtle for external perception. The amoebic mass with countless eyes expanded outward, its form spreading across the battlefield while releasing seas of crimson Undifferentiation that flowed toward Noah’s forces like tides seeking to dissolve everything in their path. The crustacean-configured Terror added its own authority to the assault, armored segments opening to release waves of corruption that merged with the crimson seas. The constantly shifting Terror contributed chaos to the combination, its unstable form producing undifferentiation that flickered between states in ways that made prediction impossible.
The seas of crimson Undifferentiation spread across THE Wastes with hunger that had consumed civilizations.
And the Undivided One responded with its own assault.

Its multiple heads opened simultaneously, and from each throat emerged an obsidian pillar of undifferentiation that shot upward before splitting and dividing and multiplying. One pillar became ten. Ten became a hundred. A hundred became thousands. Millions of obsidian pillars clouded THE Wastes within moments, each one carrying authority that could unmake Absolutes through sustained contact, each one seeking targets with primitive hunger that knew only consumption.
The combined assault would have devastated conventional forces!
The combined assault would have required careful strategy and significant losses to overcome!
But...
Noah calmly waved his hand.
The Infinite Bulwarks stepped forth.

One hundred titans of crystalline plates and layered tentacles moved in perfect synchronization, their forms shifting from scattered positions into a unified wall that stretched across the battlefield. Their silver eyes glowed with steady light as they linked their defensive authorities along geodesic paths, each Bulwark connecting to the ones beside it until their individual protections merged into singular expression.
The seas of crimson Undifferentiation struck the wall of Bulwarks!

chapters.title: Chapter 4986: Devastation II
paragraphs: The waves washed over crystalline plates that absorbed the assault without yielding, without cracking, without showing any indication that tremendous force was being applied against them.
The corruption that had dissolved countless victims across eons simply stopped when it met Infinite defense that regenerated faster than damage could accumulate.
The millions of obsidian pillars descended upon the Bulwark formation with weight that should have crushed anything beneath their combined impact.
They struck crystalline armor that did not move a single inch.

The Bulwarks absorbed the obsidian pillars as they had absorbed the crimson seas, their Bounded Countable Infinity converting all damage received into stored energy that would fuel other applications. The assault that would have devastated armies simply ended when it met defense that extended in sequences without termination.
The Undivided One and the three Formless Terrors paused in their assault.

Confusion crossed their primitive awareness as they processed the impossibility of what they had just witnessed. Their attacks had not merely been blocked. Their attacks had been rendered irrelevant, absorbed by fortifications that showed no sign of strain from containing forces that should have overwhelmed anything at THE First Scale of Existence.
Noah waved his hand again.
"Maws. Forty of you. Ten per target."
The Hungering Maws moved with eagerness that had been building since their elevation.

Forty of the predatory Absolutes surged forward through gaps in the Bulwark formation, their tentacles writhing with barely contained violence as they split into groups of ten. Each group oriented toward one of the four enemies, their serrated maws opening to release Embodiments filled with definitions of Infinity that blazed with blue-gold light against the corruption of THE Wastes.
The first ten Maws reached the amoebic Formless Terror and demonstrated what Infinite offense truly meant.

Their Embodiments did not merely strike the Terror’s form. They defined it. They imposed Infinite structure upon churning undifferentiation, crystallizing the creature’s existence into patterns it could not escape. The Maws descended upon their target with limbs and tentacles moving like hammers and swords, bludgeoning Infinite definitions into a being that had never experienced definition forced upon it before.
The Terror tried to release more undifferentiation in response.
The attempt failed.

The Maws’ Reality Severance attacked its existence directly, bypassing the defensive mechanisms that had protected it across eons. Their Predatory Geodesic Instinct found every weakness in its distributed consciousness, every vulnerability in its countless eyes, every gap in its primordial defenses. They struck those weaknesses with Hunger that grew stronger with every moment of contact, their Infinite power stacks building as they tore into their target with brutality of absolute dominance!

Tentacles wrapped around portions of the amoebic mass and ripped them away while other tentacles crystallized what remained with Infinite definitions. Serrated maws bit into churning darkness and imposed structure that the darkness could not reject. Limbs descended like siege weapons, each impact driving more definition into existence that had known only formlessness.
DUM! DUM! DUM!
A Glorious symphony of war bloomed.
The second group of ten Maws reached the crustacean-configured Terror and repeated the demonstration.

Armored segments that had protected the creature across eons shattered under strikes that attacked existence itself rather than physical form. The core of pure undifferentiation that pulsed within those segments found itself crystallized by Embodiments that extended Infinitely, definitions arriving from angles that conventional defense could not anticipate. The Maws bludgeoned their target with the same brutal efficiency their brethren displayed!
The third group reached the constantly shifting Terror and demonstrated that chaos provided no defense against Infinite structure.
Every configuration the creature assumed found itself crystallized before the next shift could occur.
The fourth group reached the Undivided One and showed that size meant nothing against properly applied Infinity.

The serpent-centipede form that had seemed so massive moments ago found itself overwhelmed by ten Absolutes whose combined assault attacked every segment simultaneously. Multiple heads that had released millions of obsidian pillars were crystallized one after another as the Maws imposed definitions that the Undivided One’s existence could not reject. Segments that had writhed with obsidian light went still as Infinite structure replaced undifferentiated chaos.
The entire engagement lasted seconds.

The Undivided One and three Formless Terrors that had seemed so dangerous moments ago now existed only as mutilated crystallized husks scattered across the battlefield. Their forms had been frozen into configurations of Infinite definition, their undifferentiation converted into structure that would persist until something dismantled it deliberately. What had been four enemies approaching Bazuman’s level were now four collections of crystallized matter that held no consciousness, no authority, no capacity for resistance.
It was too fucking quick!
Noah looked at the results with eyes that shone with tyranny.
"Multiply the harvest by a factor of ten."
His voice carried out across his existence.
"Then further elevate it by an exponent of three."
A pause.
"And for all the harvest here to go toward the Tetras Apeiron."

The crystallized defeated enemies began breaking apart as his authority processed their remains. What had been frozen structure became flowing essence, resources extracted from collapsed existences that would fuel further advancement. The harvest flowed toward his Legions in streams of blue-gold light that the Maws and Bulwarks and Chorus and Architects absorbed with foundations hungry for growth.

|Base harvest multiplied by factor of 10, elevated by exponent of 3|
|Total harvest distributed to Tetras Apeiron|

|Results: All 400 Absolutes have received substantial foundation reinforcement. Hungering Maws who participated in direct combat have accumulated Infinite Hunger Stacks that persist beyond engagement. Bulwarks have stored absorbed damage in reservoirs available for redistribution. Overall Legion effectiveness increased by approximately 12%.|
Noah looked across THE Wastes with eyes that shone with light matching his Infinities.
Four enemies that would have required careful planning to defeat not long ago, cleared in seconds through deployment of forces he had built through mass production and Sacred Herb cultivation!
He finally felt like the Hunter again.
Not the hunted, reacting to threats that emerged faster than he could address them. Not the defender, protecting territories from forces that seemed to multiply endlessly.
The Hunter, seeking targets and eliminating them with prejudice, growing stronger with every victory while his enemies grew weaker through attrition they could not reverse.
This was what Infinite warfare looked like.
"Where to next?"
He asked Infinite Undifferentiated Fate once more, reaching through the threads of destiny and Mana that connected him to targets across Observable Existence.
The golden strands burned before his awareness, each one leading to enemies worthy of his attention, each one representing opportunity for further demonstration of what he had built.
The Tetras Apeiron stood ready behind him, four hundred Absolutes awaiting their master’s command.

Not the hunted, reacting to threats that emerged faster than he could address them.
Not the defender, protecting territories from forces that seemed to multiply endlessly.
The Hunter, seeking targets and eliminating them with prejudice, growing stronger with every victory while his enemies grew weaker through attrition they could not reverse.
This was what Infinite warfare looked like.
"Where to next?"
He asked Infinite Undifferentiated Fate once more, reaching through the threads of destiny and Mana that connected him to targets across Observable Existence.
The golden strands burned before his awareness, each one leading to enemies worthy of his attention, each one representing opportunity for further demonstration of what he had built.
The Tetras Apeiron stood ready behind him, four hundred Absolutes awaiting their master’s command.

chapters.title: Chapter 4987: Loyalty I
paragraphs: Noah was swimming through the weavings of Infinite Undifferentiated Fate.

Golden threads stretched in every direction around his consciousness, each one a connection to something across Observable Existence, each one a potential path toward targets and conflicts and opportunities. His Countable Infinities extended his perception in sequential progressions that allowed him to feel the vast web of his influence spreading outward from this point in THE Wastes, touching territories and beings and events he had never consciously directed his attention toward.
He was looking at the next nearest thing that would be connected to him.

The approach was deliberate. He felt like a gardener clearing away weeds closest to his core weavings, eliminating threats that could spread if left unchecked while avoiding the exhaustion of stretching himself too thin across Observable Existence. The Tetras Apeiron stood ready behind him, four hundred Absolutes awaiting direction toward whatever enemy he selected. Skoll circled nearby with loyal patience that asked no questions about methodology or purpose.
He felt a few weavings here and there that were pulling at his awareness.

One was another Undivided One drifting through a region of THE Wastes not far from his current position. Another was a lone Formless Terror that had emerged from THE Prima Indifferentia and was currently consuming whatever crossed its path. A third was something that his perception could not fully identify, but that definitely held enough authority to warrant attention.
He planned to go on a systematic hunt, one target after another, collecting loot to empower himself and his army while eliminating threats that could complicate his preparations.

The Tetras Apeiron was only four hundred Absolutes. Soon there would be thousands under his command, each one elevated through mass production and Sacred Herb cultivation, each one carrying Bounded Countable Infinity that made conventional forces seem obsolete by comparison.
But just as he was about to make a decision on one particular weaving, something changed.
"Huh?"
Noah blinked.

He frowned as he felt extremely distant weavings relating to him and connected to him, but these weavings seemed different from the others. They seemed closed off, as if they did not want to be found. As if they did not want him to even turn his gaze in their direction. The threads that connected those distant weavings to his awareness were muted and obscured, deliberately hidden through methods that his initial perception could not immediately penetrate.
Something that was connected to him, and yet it did not want him to know it existed?
That made no sense.

His Infinities spread across Observable Existence through Seals and corrupted proto-matter and direct investment. Anything connected to those Infinities should welcome his attention, should benefit from his awareness, should have no reason to hide from the source of the authority they carried.
Unless whatever was happening in those distant weavings was something that connection alone could not protect.
Noah became more serious.

He focused all his Countable Infinities on tracking down the obscured connection, Infinite Undifferentiated Fate burning around his fingers with intensity that pressed against THE Wastes themselves. Golden light spread outward from his position, saturating the entire region with the color of fate being read and destiny being perceived. The corrupted proto-matter in the surroundings served as medium for his perception, the Infinite Seals scattered throughout THE Wastes amplifying his ability to trace connections that did not wish to be traced.
The Tetras Apeiron stood in perfect stillness as their master worked.
Skoll ceased his circling, the loyal companion sensing that something important was occurring.
Moments later, Noah’s expression changed drastically.

The golden light around him intensified as information began flowing through the connection he had forced open. The weavings he was reading related to someone he had not thought about in some time, someone who had parted ways with him.
The Peacemaker.
Alexander Asmodeus.
Someone from his home Wheel of Existence who had chosen his own path rather than remaining under Noah’s protection.

The more his weavings of Infinite Undifferentiated Fate uncovered regarding the fate and choices of this being, the heavier Noah’s expression became. The information arrived in fragments that his perception assembled into coherent narrative, each fragment darker than the last, each piece of the picture more disturbing than what had come before.
|Weaving Analysis: Alexander Asmodeus, THE Peacemaker|

|Status: Branded with the Mark of Horus. Existence burning continuously since branding occurred. Forced cultivation elevating his Depth toward Absolute through methods that consume his foundations rather than strengthening them properly.|

|Recent Events: Due to his historical connection with you, at a point immediately preceding your weavings connecting with weavings of Paradox, another entity was led toward THE Peacemaker’s location. This entity followed trails of corrupted Infinity that you had spread across THE Wastes, trails that led to beings who had been associated with your authority.|

|Entity Classification: Unknown designation. Aura signature suggests Primordial Architect classification. However, recorded authority levels from brief observation exceed known weavings of existence at THE First Scale. Theoretical assessment: This entity operates at THE Second Scale of Existence.|

|Interaction Record: The entity offered salvation to THE Peacemaker in exchange for information regarding your connection and origin as the one who holds the Infinities spreading across Observable Existence. The entity sought knowledge of your location, your nature, your vulnerabilities.|
|THE Peacemaker’s Response: Denied the offer. Did not provide information. Did not give you up.|

|Consequence: THE Peacemaker has been suffering since then. Duration of suffering unknown but estimated at significant dilated temporal span. Means of power at THE Second Scale that cannot be understood currently.|
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes were heavy as they looked at these prompts.
The Peacemaker.
Alexander, who had faced Adversity that seemed ridiculously above what any reasonable assessment would have predicted for someone at his level of development.

And when he had the chance to clear that Adversity by giving Noah up, by providing information that would redirect the Primordial Architect’s attention toward its actual target, by saving himself through the simple act of betrayal...
He did not do so.

The one responsible for Alexander’s current suffering was something hunting for Noah specifically. A Primordial Architect theorized to operate at THE Second Scale of Existence, following trails of corrupted Infinity that Noah had spread across Observable Existence, seeking the source of the authority that had drawn its attention.
One of the worst possible variables that Noah had only just begun preparing for, one of the threats that had motivated the creation of the Tetras Apeiron in the first place.
An enemy at THE Second Scale.
And yet, when the question came whether Noah should put himself in danger to save THE Peacemaker who had not given him up, it was not even a question.
He began to move right away.

The Tetras Apeiron shifted into travel formation behind him, four hundred Absolutes responding to their master’s decision without hesitation or inquiry. Protos moved to Noah’s side. Skoll followed with loyal certainty that asked no questions about destination or purpose.
As they moved, Noah began to speak.

His voice carried across THE Wastes with weight that made the corrupted proto-matter seem to still, the words emerging with cadence that spoke of prophecy rather than mere statement. The legion of Absolutes around him began to repeat his words, their combined voices creating chorus that pressed against existence itself.
"The adversity that breaks all others shall forge him."
Four hundred voices echoed the declaration.
"The hardship that ends all paths shall begin his."
The words spread outward in waves that carried meaning beyond mere sound.
"The Scales demand what the Scales demand, and he shall pay in currencies that have not yet been minted."
Noah continued speaking as they traveled, his voice steady despite the weight of what he was walking toward.

"Three times shall he face the mirror of undoing. Three times shall he choose between becoming and unbecoming. Three times shall the answer be the same, and three times shall the answer be different."
The Tetras Apeiron repeated each line with precision that made the Echo feel like inevitability rather than possibility.
"This is what shall come to pass, for it has already passed, and it shall pass again."
Noah paused.
"The wheel turns. The river flows. The question echoes."
The final words hung in the air as the legion fell silent, their repetition complete.
Noah thought about the echo as he sighed and uttered out again.
"Right. The wheel turns. The river flows."

He had Adversity in THE Entity, that unified horror that had claimed THE Primordial Chaos and threatened everything he was building. He had Adversity in the Primordial Architects awakening across THE Prima Indifferentia, ancient beings whose power approached or exceeded THE Second Scale.
He had Adversity in the simple fact that existence was vast and filled with terrors that did not care about his ambitions or his preparations or his Infinite nature.
But for the sake of someone who had defended him when defense cost everything, he would do the same.
Alexander had not given him up.
Noah would not abandon someone who had demonstrated such conviction.

This in itself was a choice that rational assessment might question. No one sane would put themselves in front of an entity at an entirely higher Scale of Existence. No one calculating would risk everything they had built to save a single being who had chosen to walk away from their protection.
No one focused purely on advancement would divert from systematic hunting to confront a threat they were not yet prepared to defeat.
But sometimes, ones had to do what they had to do.

The Tetras Apeiron followed their master toward confrontation with something that operated at THE Second Scale, four hundred Absolutes with Bounded Countable Infinity marching toward battle that conventional wisdom said they could not win.
Oh.
Oh.
